description: This file contains unit tests for the GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer, which suggests adding [Alias] attributes to various types and methods related to Orleans grain interfaces and serializable types. The tests verify that diagnostics are correctly triggered or suppressed based on the presence of [Alias] and [GenerateSerializer] attributes.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class for Verify the diagnostic behavior of GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer regarding Orleans interfaces and serializable types.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Checks that the provided code produces the expected diagnostics.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Checks that the provided code does not produce diagnostics.
